_doc: Score segments for the trailer (REVISED 2: the programming is heard). The bed (song or public score) carries the arc; the game's coding groove (videos/audio2/groove, 112.5 BPM 3/4, F minor, timeline-aligned) is LAYERED under the proof split screen and under the programming cuts of the montage. Entries/exits are snapped to cue-sheet downbeats; equal-power crossfades complete on the entry downbeat and start on the exit downbeat. mode: layer | replace (replace fades the bed out under the segment). 'clips': 'programming' = one segment per run of programming clips in the EDL (clip.programming / audio.programming / section proof / shot name). Levels are relative to the bed's normalisation and are set so the loudness-curve gate still passes (proof bed >= 6 dB under the montage; payoff loudest).

segments._why: a quiet programming pulse under the split screen; the proof bed stays submerged (the bed dips 0.8 dB under it, so the proof section keeps its energy and the loudness-curve gate is unaffected)
